g.text: MOTOR 2 / independent single-shunt feedback and common hardware shutdown

g.desc: MOTOR 2 / independent single-shunt feedback and common hardware shutdown

g.text: 100V MOSFETs; local SMA bootstrap diodes; prototype 20kHz PWM

g.desc: 100V MOSFETs; local SMA bootstrap diodes; prototype 20kHz PWM

g.text: M2: TIM3 PA6/PA7/PB0 PWM; PB6/PB7/PB8 enables; PB1 ADC9 current. TIM1 remains motor1. No firmware yet.

g.desc: M2: TIM3 PA6/PA7/PB0 PWM; PB6/PB7/PB8 enables; PB1 ADC9 current. TIM1 remains motor1. No firmware yet.

g.text: TARGET: 12S1P A123 26650 + two Boosted Board V1 motors. Exact cell revision and motor ratings still to confirm.

g.desc: TARGET: 12S1P A123 26650 + two Boosted Board V1 motors. Exact cell revision and motor ratings still to confirm.

g.text: Hardware enable: PA0 + reset + emergency loop + phase requests

g.desc: Hardware enable: PA0 + reset + emergency loop + phase requests

g.text: 12S1P A123 26650 battery input / reverse protection / DC link

g.desc: 12S1P A123 26650 battery input / reverse protection / DC link

g.text: Dump chopper: hysteresis, stability and pulse energy still to check.

g.desc: Dump chopper: hysteresis, stability and pulse energy still to check.

g.text: Single low-side shunt: synchronous sampling/reconstruction required; blind switching states and reverse/regen current not covered by INA180.

g.desc: Single low-side shunt: synchronous sampling/reconstruction required; blind switching states and reverse/regen current not covered by INA180.

g.text: Shared 20A fuse is not an electronic battery limiter. Pack/BMS charge, discharge, cold-temperature and cell imbalance limits remain required.

g.desc: Shared 20A fuse is not an electronic battery limiter. Pack/BMS charge, discharge, cold-temperature and cell imbalance limits remain required.

g.text: 12S A123: chopper ~48V on / ~47.4V off. Still to do: U11 transient protection, precharge, feedback and cooling.

g.desc: 12S A123: chopper ~48V on / ~47.4V off. Still to do: U11 transient protection, precharge, feedback and cooling.

g.text: Gate-drive interfaces for the three motor phases

g.desc: Gate-drive interfaces for the three motor phases

g.text: 12V hysteretic buck: output ESR and ripple need bench verification

g.desc: 12V hysteretic buck: output ESR and ripple need bench verification

g.text: 9mF at43.2V stores8.398J. External precharge/contact sequencing needed. No automatic precharge on the board.

g.desc: 9mF at43.2V stores8.398J. External precharge/contact sequencing needed. No automatic precharge on the board.

g.text: LM74500:60V recommended /65V absolute max;43.2V steady state compatible; SMCJ45A 72.7V clamp is above that limit. Keep regen off until BMS and energy handling are sorted.

g.desc: LM74500:60V recommended /65V absolute max;43.2V steady state compatible; SMCJ45A 72.7V clamp is above that limit. Keep regen off until BMS and energy handling are sorted.

g.text: 12V supervisor threshold nominal 11.50V; open CT delay ~20ms

g.desc: 12V supervisor threshold nominal 11.50V; open CT delay ~20ms

g.text: Receiver: 0-3.3V pulse; external power; common ground

g.desc: Receiver: 0-3.3V pulse; external power; common ground

g.text: MOTOR 2 / PHASE C - independent half bridge

g.desc: MOTOR 2 / PHASE C - independent half bridge

g.text: Current sense / hardware overcurrent / bus voltage / dump control

g.desc: Current sense / hardware overcurrent / bus voltage / dump control

g.text: External dump resistor: 10ohm for now; energy, pulse duty and heatsink rating still to work out.

g.desc: External dump resistor: 10ohm for now; energy, pulse duty and heatsink rating still to work out.

g.text: Contact opens => stop. Firmware must require re-arm after stop.

g.desc: Contact opens => stop. Firmware must require re-arm after stop.

g.text: MOTOR 2 / PHASE B - independent half bridge

g.desc: MOTOR 2 / PHASE B - independent half bridge

g.text: MOTOR 2 / PHASE A - independent half bridge

g.desc: MOTOR 2 / PHASE A - independent half bridge

g.text: 9mF DC link; precharge required before main power connection

g.desc: 9mF DC link; precharge required before main power connection

g.text: Control, timing, reset and boot configuration

g.desc: Control, timing, reset and boot configuration

g.text: Each bridge: 2 x 10mOhm parallel, gain20 => 0.100V/A; nominal trip 24.775A. Overcurrent trip threshold only, not a set motor current limit.

g.desc: Each bridge: 2 x 10mOhm parallel, gain20 => 0.100V/A; nominal trip 24.775A. Overcurrent trip threshold only, not a set motor current limit.
